flag_semantics: Advantage/benefit flags denote supported claims under the pushed preregistration, not whether any favorable cell was observed. Registered 6/6 complete pairs show an observed configured-pattern benefit (reconstructable0 vs3, task6/6 each), but preregistration requires complete formal evidence and clean utility is lower. Do not select a superiority claim from the incomplete overall run. Ready for review means review of partial and negative evidence, not publication clearance.
